title: Alondra1 tag (v1)
description: A reusable personal label for mail, notes, tasks and calendar events (FEATURES_EXTENSION Part B §2). Names are unique per owner and space among live tags, compared after trimming, Unicode NFC and case folding; the display casing is kept. Assignments are separate tag_link records that name the tag by id, so a rename changes nothing else. Color is a theme token; tags never rely on color alone.

name.description: At most 64 characters (Unicode code points) after trimming; no control characters.
